# Bundled source code

`smartmontools-7.5.tar.gz` is the official smartmontools 7.5 source distribution:

https://github.com/smartmontools/smartmontools/releases/download/RELEASE_7_5/smartmontools-7.5.tar.gz

SHA-256: `690b83ca331378da9ea0d9d61008c4b22dde391387b9bbad7f29387f2595f76e`

`scripts/build.sh` verifies the archive checksum, builds smartctl from this source, and installs the `drivedb.h` database beside the application.
